title: A/B Harness Engine Integration
purpose: Determine how the harness selects and invokes each engine before story 6 implementation begins.

questions.label: Engine selector
questions.prompt: How should ab_build.sh switch between OpenAI Codex and Anthropic Claude? Options: (a) an ENGINE env var read by oneshot_phased.sh, (b) a --engine flag passed to oneshot_phased.sh, (c) separate wrapper scripts per engine. Which approach fits the existing script conventions best?

questions.label: Codex invocation
questions.prompt: The current pipeline calls `claude -p` for Claude. What is the equivalent CLI call for OpenAI Codex — is it already available, does it require a separate install, or should the harness stub Framework 1 as a placeholder for now?

questions.label: Scoring judge model
questions.prompt: For guardrail ACs that cannot be verified by pytest (e.g. "no raw content leaks"), the scorer uses an LLM judge. Should the judge be Claude (claude-sonnet-4-6), a cheaper model (haiku), or configurable? What confidence threshold triggers a fail?
